quests.title: Missing Wallet
quests.description: Maria lost her wallet at the plaza. Help her find it.

objectives.description: Talk to Maria at the plaza
Ask the vendor about the wallet

quests.title: Alex's Secret
quests.description: Alex will open up once you gain his trust and prove you're charming/smart.

objectives.description: Talk to Alex at the plaza after school (15:30-18:00)

quests.title: Gym Initiation
quests.description: Ben respects strength. Train at the park gym to earn his respect.

objectives.description: Talk to Ben at the café after 17:00
Spar with Ben at the park

quests.title: First Shift at The Roast
quests.description: Lena needs a reliable hand behind the counter. Prove you can handle the lunch rush and earn your first paycheck.

objectives.description: Meet Lena at the café during open hours
Finish your closing shift and collect your pay

quests.title: Midterm Study Group
quests.description: The library study group is meeting to prep for midterms. Join them to boost your education and make new friends.

objectives.description: Head to the library after school
Score well on the midterm practice quiz

quests.title: A Gift for Maria
quests.description: Maria's birthday is coming up. Find a thoughtful gift she'll actually like — not something generic from the supermarket.

objectives.description: Pick out a meaningful gift at the mall
Give the gift to Maria on her birthday

quests.title: Milo the Missing Cat
quests.description: Mrs. Delgado's cat Milo vanished near the park. The whole block is looking — can you track him down?

objectives.description: Talk to Mrs. Delgado at her home

quests.title: Kitchen Basics
quests.description: You keep burning toast. Learn to cook a proper meal so you can take care of yourself — and impress someone special.

quests.title: The Rent Comes Due
quests.description: Your room's rent is overdue. The landlord gave you until the end of day 7 to pay up or find another place to sleep.

objectives.description: Pay the landlord what you owe

quests.title: Weekend Reset
quests.description: You've been grinding all week. Take Saturday off — visit the beach or amusement park to recharge your happiness.

objectives.description: Spend time at the beach or amusement park
